title: Croatian Stew with Tender Meats
description: A hearty and flavorful keto stew made with tender meats and a variety of vegetables. The croatian stew is a traditional dish that has been adapted to fit a keto diet.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it's translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the tender croatian beef and cook until it's browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the peas, tomato paste, beef broth, and paprika. Stir well to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
